title: The Market Caravan
text: A caravan no gate-ward saw arrive camps in the Commons. Its traders wear veils even to eat, and their camels do not blink. They sell things nobody here has seen: salt from the bottom of a dead sea, glass that remembers, lamp oil that burns black.

options.label: Buy rare materials from the veiled traders, whoever they are (40 Gold).

outcomes.text: The strange stuff comes carefully wrapped. Nobody remembers the traders' faces, only their hands.

options.label: Look, but buy nothing; nothing that arrives unseen should be trusted.

outcomes.text: By morning the caravan is gone, along with its wheel ruts, the camels' tracks and every memory of their faces.
